title: My ASMR mic recorded someone breathing 🎙️
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark moody blue-teal grade, one bright light source, well exposed, 35mm film grain, realistic, no text, no watermark, no faces
hook_text: At 2:09 a.m. my ASMR mic recorded someone breathing behind the camera.

scenes.narration: At 2:09 a.m. my ASMR mic recorded someone breathing behind the camera.
I bought a new microphone for my ASMR videos. Soft tapping. Quiet whispering. Every night at two, I record for an hour.

shots.prompt: desk with a studio microphone, headphones and a small lamp in the dark, no person

scenes.narration: That night I put on the headphones to check the sound. The tapping was clean. The whispering was clean. And under it, a slow rasp.

shots.prompt: headphones resting on a desk next to a glowing laptop, dark room, no text, no person

scenes.narration: I paused the recording. The rasp stopped. I pressed play. It started again. In, out. In, out. Wet and slow.

shots.prompt: laptop screen with a bright audio waveform in a dark room, no text, no face

scenes.narration: I checked the room. Locked door. Empty chair. The only breathing I could hear was my own. And it did not match the recording.

shots.prompt: dark home studio with an empty chair behind the desk, lamp glow, no person

scenes.narration: I zoomed into the waveform. The breathing was not behind the microphone. It was inside the left headphone. Right against my ear.

shots.prompt: close view of a headphone with a bright audio waveform reflected on it, dark, no face

scenes.narration: I tore the headphones off. Silence. Then, through the speakers, my own whisper from an hour ago said, quietly, he can hear you.

shots.prompt: studio microphone with a pop filter, lamp flickering, shadow on the wall, no person

scenes.narration: The red light on the microphone was still on. It had not stopped recording.

shots.prompt: small red recording light glowing on a studio microphone in the dark, no person

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you listen to the whole recording, or delete it?

post.caption: At 2:09 a.m. my ASMR mic recorded someone… 🎙️ A: listen or B: delete it? Comment A or B 👇 Want Part 2? Comment YES #horrortok #storytime #horrorstoriestok #scarystories #fyp
